notes: Volume holds the 'Elección de Diputados por agrupación electoral' table (pp.4-27; left page parties Agrario..Demócrata Nacionalista, facing right page Falange Nacional..Independientes and Totales generales), then the list of elected deputies by agrupación (pp.32-35). The table gives per party candidates presented/elected and votes, by comuna, departamento and agrupación; no candidate votes and no null/blank votes are printed. Contest numbers are sequential (1-28): Santiago's 7th agrupación is split into its three districts (contests 7-9), so contest n>=10 is official agrupación n-2 (contest 10 = 8.a Agrupación). National row (TOTAL REPUBLICA, p.26-27): 367 presented, 147 elected, 449.930 votes, 641.495 inscritos. Falange Nacional national figure on p.27 reads like 11.665 but is unclear; the summary on p.31 and the synoptic table on p.29 print 11.565, which is recorded. National party totals are as printed otherwise. Party names in candidate 'party' are as typed in the elected list (upper case, no accents). 'candidates_presented' is an extra field holding the printed Presentados count. Pages 28-30 hold a typed synoptic table by agrupación (party presented/elected/votes, totals, inscritos), used to cross-check every figure; p.31 the party summary and Observaciones (results of the complementary elections of 10 June 1945 are not included). Pages 1-3 are front matter.
